text.en:
Today you say where you are.
Je suis ici. = I am here.
Je means “I”. Ici means “here”.
Suis means “am”. English has this word too.
Tu es ici. = You are here.
Tu means “you”. Es means “are”.

Every phrase has three parts: who, am/are/is, where.
Je suis là. = I am there.
Là means “there”.
The middle word changes with the person.
Je goes with suis. Tu goes with es.
Léa est ici. = Léa is here. Est means “is”.

Next you build short phrases from word tiles.
Look at the first tile: who is it about?
Pick the middle word that goes with that person.
Then add the place: ici or là.
Example: Tu es là. = You are there.
